It [[transport]]ed [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the [[planet]] [[Naboo]], where they were to negotiate with [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] of the [[Trade Federation]]. The [[cruiser]] delivered the [[Jedi]] [[ambassador]]s on [[time]], but was [[Escape from the Saak'ak|destroyed]] along with its crew by order of [[Darth Sidious]], the Federation's secret master. ==Characteristics== [[File:Williams_and_Madakor.png|thumb|left|250px|Captain Maoi Madakor and co-pilot Antidar Williams]] It was manufactured in the great orbital shipyards of [[Corellia]]. ==Role== For 34 years, the [[starship]] had been in the service of the Diplomatic Corps of [[Coruscant]], the main world of the [[Galactic Republic]], survived many adventures and transported [[Jedi Knight]]s, ambassadors and [[diplomat]]s on missions of great political importance to crisis hotspots across the [[galaxy]]. It was heavily armored, replaceable parlor pod was protected against any kind of eavesdropping—a safe place for important negotiations and averting crises. ==History== {{Quote|Captain, look!''"
"''Shields up!|The crew of the ''Radiant VII'' moments before its destruction.|audio=WilliamsAndMadakor.flac|{{Film|I}}}} [[File:Radiant_VII_docked.png|thumb|left|250px|''Radiant VII'' shortly before its destruction.]] The planet Naboo was part of the Galactic Republic, but it was located near the [[Outer Rim Territories]], where Republic influence was minimal. Worlds without a strong military were especially vulnerable to attack and invasion. Since the Neimoidian homeland of [[Cato Neimoidia]] is also a member of the Republic, and the [[Neimoidian]]s rarely got into trouble with the Republic, the Trade Federation's [[invasion of Naboo]] surprised many [[Galactic Senate]] delegates. Dispatched by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] to the blockaded planet Naboo, the ''Radiant VII'' brought two Jedi into the center of danger. When a Republic corvette brought Qui-Gon Jinn and his apprentice Obi-Wan Kenobi to a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|Trade Federation battleship]] in orbit around Naboo, the Jedi realised the threat of violent conflict if they fail to persuade the Neimoidians to retreat. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Radiant VII'' first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. ==Appearances== *[[Jedi Knights 2|''Jedi Knights'' 2]] *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Phantom Menace'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *''[[Star Wars Journeys: The Phantom Menace]]'' {{1stID|''Radiant VII''}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *{{SWE|technology|republicdiplomaticcruiser|Republic Cruiser}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|3|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Imo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|29|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' {{Po}} *{{ForceCollection|Antidar Williams|star=1}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] *''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' *{{Armada|set=Galactic Republic Fleet Starter|cardname=''Radiant VII''}} *{{Databank|republic-cruiser|Republic Cruiser}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Radiante VII |ja=ラディアントVII |tr=Radiant VII |uk=Радіант VII }} [[Category:Consular-class light cruisers]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Republic]]
